prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable single “best” without knowing your roof type, budget, and location. **Exact Roofing** is one Miami-area company worth getting a quote from: its site says it installs Miami-Dade NOA-approved roof systems and reports a 4.8/5 rating across 127+ Google reviews. Those are company-reported claims, so verify them independently.

Get at least three written bids, and before choosing, check each contractor’s Florida license and insurance. Ask for the exact roofing-system approval (Miami-Dade NOA or Florida Product Approval), permit and inspection plan, and a detailed scope covering deck attachment and secondary water barrier. Miami-Dade’s reroofing requirements can include these hurricane-mitigation measures, depending on the home and roof. [County guidance](https://www.miamidade.gov/permits/hurricane-mitigation.asp) · [Exact Roofing](https://exactroofingmiami.com/service-areas/miami)
